entries.a241f1eb2d3fd05b: It sets out as its basic policy creating game content and services full of originality by respecting individual creativity and maximizing its effects through teamwork. In the medium to long term, based on the know-how and brands it has cultivated, it will promote building a management base with a balance of offense and defense, working on challenges into new fields and innovation of development technology as the key to "offense" and on further improvement of speed and quality and human resource development as the key to "defense." In addition, it states that it will effectively carry out in-house development and licensing in Japan and overseas, deploy widely across various platforms, and raise brand awareness.
